paragraphs:
Shmuel. R' Hanina bar Shmuel; Yehudah bar Shmuel; Levi bar Shmuel; Rav Pappa bar Shmuel; Rav bar Shmuel; Rabbah bar Shmuel; Rami bar Shmuel. Concerning Hanina, Yehudah, and Rav, we do not know which Shmuel's sons they were.

[Glosses: Shmuel. (a) Bekhorot 11b: “Rabbi Shmuel said in R' Hanina's name.” Rabbi is a scribal error, since he was not ordained. Not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”, here and below]. (b) Nedarim 55a: the son of Mar Shmuel ordered twelve thousand zuz to be given to Rava. So too in the new Talmud editions. (c) Bava Kamma 99a: “Shmuel bar Aha said ….” Tosafot, Bava Metzia 112a, s.v. Umman, have “Rav Ashi bar Hama said”: certainly a scribal error. (d) Megillah 8b: Rav Shmuel bar Yitzhak taught before Rav Huna; “Rava said to him.” The word “to him” is a scribal error, for Rava did not see Rav Huna. (e) Yoma 11b: Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah taught before Rava. In my humble opinion, it appears that he did not live in his time. Not corrected. (f) Shabbat 29a, 59b, 146b: Rav Shmuel bar bar Hana; elsewhere, the son of Rabbah bar bar Hana. (g) Shabbat 85a, 102a: R' Shmuel bar Nehemyah said in the name of R. Y. [אר״י]. It should read Nahmani; so too in Ein Yaakov and the new Talmud editions. (h) Sukkah 43b: “R' Shmuel bar Natan said in R' Hanina's name”—this is the correct reading, and so it is in the new Talmud editions.]
